_recipe.title: Testimonial proof
_recipe.when: Turn real customer reviews into a trust-building feed ad or post (1:1): D2C brands, clinics, coaches, agencies, local services.
beats: Hook: the headline proof number (customers, rating, orders) counts up.
Review 1: the most specific review, with name, city and stars.
Review 2: a different benefit, a different kind of customer.
Before / after: what changed for customers, in their words.
Why people trust you: four facts as tiles (rating, delivery, returns, payments).
CTA: one action, the offer, where to go.
copyTips: Only real reviews, quoted word for word (trim, never rewrite meaning), with the customer's permission. Stars only if the review had them.
Pick reviews that name a concrete result ("faded in three weeks") over generic praise ("great product").
Use first name + initial and city ("Priya S., Pune") unless the customer agreed to their full name.
Clean + smooth + relaxed gives reviews time to be read. Food / kids brands: --theme pop. Luxury: --theme editorial.
For Reels / Stories use --format reel; for feed ads keep square or use --format portrait.
